DOCUMENT STRUCTURE
- <!DOCTYPE html>, <html lang="en">, meta charset UTF-8, <title>Neural Growth Simulation</title>, head style, body containing a centered .wrap div with: <canvas id="net" width="800" height="800">, an absolutely-positioned overlay label (top-left) reading "NEURAL GROWTH // LIVE" in color #ffd400 monospace 11px letter-spacing 3px with text-shadow 0 0 8px rgba(255,212,0,.6) and pointer-events:none, and a status div (bottom-right, id="status") in color #00e5ff monospace 10px letter-spacing 2px opacity .7.
- CSS: html,body{margin:0;background:#05070f;height:100%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden} ; canvas display:block background #05070f with box-shadow 0 0 90px rgba(16,26,58,.9); .wrap position:relative.
- All JS in one <script> with 'use strict'; organized into clearly commented sections in this exact order:
  // ===== SETUP =====
  // ===== GUI =====
  // ===== NEURON GROWTH =====
  // ===== SYNAPSE DETECTION =====
  // ===== PULSE ANIMATION =====
  // ===== RENDERING =====
  // ===== MAIN LOOP =====

SETUP SECTION
- canvas ctx (2d), W=800,H=800; an offscreen canvas `off` 800×800 with `offCtx` used to accumulate finished branches for performance.
- params object P with defaults: neuronCount:5, growthSpeed:2.2, maxDepth:5, splitChance:0.75, curvature:0.4, maxBranchLen:120, synapseDist:34, synapseGlow:14, pulseSpeed:1.6, pulseFreq:1.2, pulseBrightness:1.4, backgroundColor:'#05070f', branchColor:'#00e5ff', accentColor:'#d6ff00', synapseColor:'#ff2bd6', pulseColor:'#fff36a', scanlines:true.
- state: neurons=[], branches=[], active=[] (growing tips), synapses=[], pulses=[], seen=new Set() (duplicate synapse keys), growing=false, paused=false, time=0, lastPulse=0, frame=0.
- helpers: rand(a,b); hexA(hex,a) converting '#rrggbb' + alpha to 'rgba(r,g,b,a)' string.

GUI SECTION
- new dat.GUI(); four folders, each .open(): 
  Growth folder controls (each with .name() exactly as follows): 'neuron count' (P.neuronCount, 3,6,1) with .onFinishChange(regenerate); 'growth speed' (growthSpeed, 0.5,6,0.1); 'max branch depth' (maxDepth, 2,8,1); 'branch split chance' (splitChance, 0,1,0.01); 'branch curvature' (curvature, 0,1,0.01); 'max branch length' (maxBranchLen, 40,220,1).
  Synapses folder: 'distance threshold' (synapseDist, 8,90,1); 'glow strength' (synapseGlow, 0,30,0.5).
  Pulses folder: 'pulse speed' (pulseSpeed, 0.2,4,0.05); 'pulse frequency' (pulseFreq, 0.1,5,0.05); 'pulse brightness' (pulseBrightness, 0.2,3,0.05).
  Visuals folder: addColor for 'background color' (backgroundColor), 'branch color' (branchColor, .onChange(redrawBranches)), 'accent branch color' (accentColor, .onChange(redrawBranches)), 'synapse color', 'pulse color'; plus 'scanlines' (P.scanlines).
- Root buttons on gui (not in a folder), on an `actions` object: 'regenerate network' -> regenerate(); 'clear canvas' -> clearAll(); 'pause/resume animation' -> togglePause() which flips `paused` and updates status text to 'PAUSED' or previous state.

NEURON GROWTH SECTION
- MAX_BRANCHES = 900 cap.
- spawnBranch(x,y,angle,neuron,depth,thick,accent): guard branches.length>=MAX_BRANCHES; push {x,y,angle,depth,thick,accent,neuron,len:0,points:[{x,y}],synapseCount:0,id:branches.length} into both branches and active.
- regenerate(): reset neurons/branches/active/synapses/pulses/seen, offCtx.clearRect, then create P.neuronCount|0 seed neurons at random positions within ±130 px of center with soma radius rand(4,7); for each neuron spawn 2-3 root branches at random angles, thickness rand(1.6,2.6), depth 0, accent=Math.random()<0.2; growing=true; setStatus('GROWING').
- stepGrowth(): iterate active backwards; per branch: wobble angle += rand(-1,1)*(0.1+0.45*P.curvature); move by step = 1+P.growthSpeed px in angle direction; push new point; len += step. Occasionally (if depth<maxDepth && len>18 && Math.random()<0.035) spawn a smaller side branch at angle ± rand(0.5,1.1), thickness*0.55, depth+1, random accent chance 0.25. Kill branch if outside canvas +20px margin. When len>=P.maxBranchLen: finish it (draw onto offscreen via drawBranch(offCtx,b), remove from active) and if depth<P.maxDepth && branches.length<MAX_BRANCHES && Math.random()<P.splitChance spawn two children at angle ± rand(0.35,0.8) with thickness*0.72, depth+1, random accent chance 0.25. When active becomes empty and growing was true: growing=false; setStatus('STABLE // PULSING').
- Note: drawBranch and setStatus are defined in RENDERING section (hoisted function declarations are fine).

SYNAPSE DETECTION SECTION
- detectSynapses(): for each branch a in active, take its last point pa; loop over ALL branches b with b.neuron!==a.neuron, take b's last point pb; if squared distance < P.synapseDist^2: key = min(a.id,b.id)+'_'+max(...); skip if seen.has(key) or a.synapseCount>2 or b.synapseCount>2; else add key to seen, increment both synapseCount, push synapse {a,b,x:(pa.x+pb.x)/2,y:(pa.y+pb.y)/2,phase:rand(0,Math.PI*2)}.

PULSE ANIMATION SECTION
- spawnPulse(): return early if no synapses; pick random synapse s; random direction; build path = branch A points (origin→tip) + synapse midpoint {x:s.x,y:s.y} + branch B points reversed (tip→origin) — WITHOUT mutating/copying arrays when avoidable (slicing/spreading is fine). Push {path, t:0}.
- stepPulses(): t += 0.010*P.pulseSpeed per frame; remove pulses with t>=1; spawn new pulse when time-lastPulse > 1/P.pulseFreq (update lastPulse), only if synapses exist.
- pulsePos(p): idx = p.t*(p.path.length-1); linear interpolation between floor/ceil points; return {x,y}.

RENDERING SECTION
- drawBranch(c,b): stroke a smoothed path through b.points using quadratic curves through midpoints (start moveTo points[0]; for k=2..end step 2 quadraticCurveTo(pts[k-1], midpoint of pts[k-1],pts[k]); final lineTo last point). lineCap/lineJoin 'round'; strokeStyle hexA(color,0.85) where color = b.accent ? P.accentColor : P.branchColor; lineWidth b.thick; shadowColor same color; shadowBlur 8. Reset shadowBlur to 0 after.
- redrawBranches(): offCtx.clearRect then drawBranch(offCtx,b) for every branch in branches.
- setStatus(txt): sets status div textContent.
- cached vignette gradient `vig` created once: radial from center, inner radius H*0.33 (transparent) to outer H*0.72 color 'rgba(5,7,15,0.85)'.
- render(): (1) fillRect background with P.backgroundColor; (2) background glow: radial gradient centered, color stops '#101a3a' at 0 → transparent at radius ~430, fillRect; (3) faint grid: strokeStyle 'rgba(0, 229, 255, 0.08)', 1px lines every 40px both axes (use +.5 offsets); (4) ctx.drawImage(off,0,0) for finished branches; (5) live-draw each branch still in active with drawBranch(ctx,b); (6) draw each neuron soma: glowing circle fill P.branchColor with shadowBlur 18 and inner white-hot core circle radius r*0.45 fill 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)'; (7) synapses: twinkle tw = 0.55+0.45*Math.sin(time*2.4+s.phase); draw a soft halo circle radius 5 (fill hexA(P.synapseColor,0.25)) and a bright core circle radius 2.2 with shadowColor P.synapseColor and shadowBlur P.synapseGlow*tw; (8) pulses: for each pulse compute pos=pulsePos(p) and a trailing point a few indices back; draw line segment trail (lineWidth 2, strokeStyle hexA(P.pulseColor,0.5), shadowBlur 10*P.pulseBrightness) plus core circle radius 2.5 fill '#ffffff' with shadowColor P.pulseColor shadowBlur 14*P.pulseBrightness; reset shadowBlur=0; (9) scanlines if P.scanlines: every 4th horizontal 1px line fillStyle 'rgba(0,229,255,0.03)'; (10) animated grain: ~40 random tiny 1-2px rects per frame fillStyle 'rgba(0,229,255,0.05)' at random positions; (11) vignette: fillStyle vig gradient fillRect full canvas.

MAIN LOOP SECTION
- loop(): requestAnimationFrame(loop) first; frame++; if !paused: time += 1/60; if growing { stepGrowth(); if (frame%4===0) detectSynapses(); } ; stepPulses(); then ALWAYS render() (so pause freezes motion but keeps frame).
- clearAll(): empty neurons, branches, active, synapses, pulses, seen; offCtx.clearRect; growing=false; setStatus('CLEARED').
- init: regenerate(); loop(); at the end. Wrap the whole script body or place script at end of body so DOM is ready.
Keep the code compact, readable, with short comments per section. Use ONLY the exact palette colors given. No brand/game/movie references anywhere.","path":"neuron_growth_zai-glm-5.3_01.html"}
